changes.title: Stabilize and polish the v0.2 workspace
changes.acceptance: On PR #9, fix the four v0.2 review defects, integrate SVAR File Explorer and Magic Bento Home, add React Bits background choices with Topography as default, and polish the built client. A separate Muse tester and GLM Flash QA reviewer independently drive the final candidate in OpenCode’s built-in browser.
